# Official AgntID offline reference

The authenticated `agntid-context.md` download is saved in this directory on
this machine. It contains the approved Quick Start, MCP/server/client guides,
runtime controls, Python SDK APIs, Simulator, OAuth, and troubleshooting.

Download source: [AgntID downloads](https://docs.agntid.ai/downloads/).
Its reported version is `development`, source commit `unknown`, and generation
time `2026-10-09T07:17:04Z`. Exact checksum and provenance are in
[setup-provenance.json](../references/setup-provenance.json).

The full downloaded reference is ignored by Git because the vendor serves it
behind authentication. To restore it on another machine, sign in, download the
AI-ready Markdown, and place it here. A complete ZIP with diagrams/assets is
also available through the same Downloads page if needed.

Use this local reference before adding an integration. Confirm current portal
behavior and SDK compatibility rather than treating a saved development build
as permanently current. Downloading documentation does not transfer login
cookies or grant an assistant access to the account.
